name: openclaw
description: OpenClaw monorepo: mobile (Expo) + desktop (Electron) clients plus the shared protocol package.

scripts.e2e:clawg-ui:local: docker compose -f e2e/docker/docker-compose.yml up --build -d && bash -c 'for i in $(seq 1 60); do status=$(docker inspect -f "{{.State.Health.Status}}" openclaw-gateway-e2e 2>/dev/null || echo missing); if [ "$status" = "healthy" ]; then break; fi; sleep 1; done' && pnpm e2e:clawg-ui; status=$?; docker compose -f e2e/docker/docker-compose.yml down --volumes; exit $status
